headline: Zoning petitions for a trade school, a church community center, a driveway, and a Family Dollar store.
summary: Petitions include a special permit for a trade school at 149 Congress Street and a special permit and variance for a community center at 465 Fletcher Street. Other petitions seek a retroactive variance for a driveway at 262 Shaw Street and a special permit for a Family Dollar store over 5,000 square feet at 565 Market Street.
items: ZBA-2026-44: Special permit to operate a trade school at 149 Congress Street, applicant Gary Gauthier
ZBA-2026-48: Special permit and variance for a community center for educational purposes at 465 Fletcher Street, applicant Transfiguration of Our Savior Greek Orthodox Church
ZBA-2026-49: Retroactive variance for a driveway expanded without a permit at 262 Shaw Street, applicant Rafael Lacereda
ZBA-2026-51: Special permit for a retail business with more than 5,000 square feet of gross floor area at 565 Market Street, applicant Family Dollar
location: City Council Chambers, 375 Merrimack Street, Lowell MA 01852
plain_text:
City of Lowell  
Zoning Board of Appeals Agenda  
  
11/23/2026 at 6:30 PM  
  
The City of Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals will hold a meeting on Monday , November 
23, 2026 at 6:30 PM.  
  
Meetings will be held in the City Council Chambers  at 375 
Merrimack Street, Lowell MA 01852 with public welcome and by using 
remote participation as follows: 
 
Members of the public may view the meeting via ltc.org, or local cable 
channel 6. Those wishing to speak regarding a specific agenda item 
shall register to speak in advance of the meeting by sending an email to 
dricker@lowellma.gov,  pcutrumbes@lowellma.gov AND 
mbrundage@lowellma.gov indicating the agenda item and a phone 
number to call so that you may be issued zoom link to the meeting. If 
no access to email, you may contact Development Services at 978-674-
4144. All requests must occur prior to 4:00PM on the day of meeting.  
 
For help with zoom please visit: Joining a Zoom meeting – Zoom Support 
 
 Review all application documents online at: https://www.lowellma.gov/1099/Zoning -Board   
 
I. Continued Business 
 
  
II. New Business 
 
ZBA-2026-44 
Petition Type: Special Permit 
Applicant: Gary Gauthier 
Property Located at: 149 Congress Street, 01852 
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Section 12.3(c) 
Petition: Gary Gauthier has applied to the Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals to operate a trade school at 149 Congress 
Street. The subject property is located in the Light Industry (LI) zoning district. The proposal requires a Special Permit 
per Section 12.3(c) to operate a trade school in this zone and any other relief required under the City of Lowell Zoning 
Ordinance. 
 
ZBA-2026-48 
Petition Type: Special Permit and Variance 
Applicant: Transfiguration of Our Savior Greek Orthodox Church 
Property Located at: 465 Fletcher Street, 01854 
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Sections 12.3(h) and 6.1 
Petition: Transfiguration of Our Savior Greek Orthodox Church has applied to The Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals 
to locate a community center for educational purposes at 465 Fletcher Street. The subject property is located in the 
Urban Multi -Family (UMF) zoning district. The project is seeking a Special Permit per Article 12.3 (h) for the
proposed use, Variance relief per Section 6.1 for changes to the parking area, and any other relief required under the 
Lowell Zoning Ordinance.   
 
ZBA-2026-49 
Petition Type: Variance 
Applicant: Rafael Lacereda 
Property Located at: 262 Shaw Street, 01851 
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Sections 5.1 and 6.1 
Petition: Rafael Lacerda has  applied to The Lowell Zoning Board of Appeal s seeking retroactive approval for a 
driveway that was expanded without a permit. The subject property is located in the Traditional Two- Family (TTF) 
zoning district. The proposal requires Variance approval per Section 5.1 for relief from the usable open spa ce 
requirement, per Section 6.1 for relief from the parking area dimensional requirements, and for any other relief 
required under the Lowell Zoning Ordinance. 
 
ZBA-2026-51 
Petition Type: Special Permit 
Applicant: Family Dollar 
Property Located at: 565 Market Street, 01852 
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Section 12.4(b) 
Petition: Family Dollar has applied to The Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals to operate a retail business with greater 
than 5,000 square feet of gross floor area. The property is located in the Urban Mixed-Use (UMU) zoning district and 
requires a Special Permit under Article 12.4.b and for any other relief required under the Lowell  Zoning Ordinance. 
 
 
III. Other Business 
 
Minutes for Approval:  
11/9/2026 
 
 
Per Order of the City of Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals – Van Pech, Chairman 
New business to be advertised by November 8, 2026 and November 15, 2026
